sanskrit_verse: यमसूक्तं तथा गाथा जपद्भिर् लौकिकाग्निना / स दग्धव्य उपेतश् चेद् आहिताग्न्यावृतार्थवत् //
transliteration: yamasūktaṃ tathā gāthā japadbhir laukikāgninā / sa dagdhavya upetaś ced āhitāgnyāvṛtārthavat //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who recites the Yama-sūkta or other sacred verses while being initiated into worldly fire rituals, and yet approaches the sacrificial fire without proper covering or intent, shall be consumed by the fire.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in alignment with ritual integrity
Causation arises from conscious participation, not mere utterance
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by internal readiness, not external performance
Restoration occurs when consciousness realigns with the consecrated act
Consciousness alignment requires both knowledge and embodiment
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs ritual utterance AND lacks proper attunement THEN consequence follows naturally through dissonance
IF agent engages sacred fire without inner preparation THEN system enforces completion through experiential correction
IF agent bypasses preparatory stages THEN capacity must be restored via guided repetition under supervision
IF agent demonstrates misaligned action THEN responsibility assumes form of corrective reintegration process
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that ceremonial or scriptural recitation alone does not confer legitimacy; the court must assess whether the actor was truly initiated and aligned in consciousness. Legal standing derives from ontological congruence, not performative compliance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that incorrect engagement with sacred fire results not from willful wrongdoing but from a lack of inner attunement. The fire consumes not as punishment but as natural consequence of incomplete initiation. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that neglecting preparatory steps leads inevitably to dissonant outcome. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in restoring the sequence rather than inflicting penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiation Completion Protocol: Re-perform initiation under qualified guidance until alignment is verified
Ritual Integrity Restoration: Engage supervised practice until energetic harmony is established
Consciousness Re-alignment Process: Undertake reflective contemplation on the meaning and purpose of each step
Sacred Fire Reconnection Ritual: Perform symbolic re-entry into fire worship with full awareness and intent
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared as Source-Authority: This law proceeds from pure Dharma, executed without punitive intent, restoring consciousness to rightful alignment. The fire judges not out of vengeance, but out of necessity for truth to manifest. Reality itself corrects where consciousness has wandered.
